Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one opaque background plate for a 2D side-on fighting-game stage. Deliver a single landscape 16:9 PNG, ideally 1672×941, at native output resolution. High-quality detailed painted game environment, sober realistic materials, faithful to the attached exact Silent Hill references. No UI, title, watermark, frame, characters, enemies, humans, silhouette, blood effects or invented symbols. This is a scene adaptation for a fixed combat camera, not a claim of exact original geometry. Keep the ground in the bottom 30% as an unobstructed horizontal fighting lane; the feet baseline is at about 87% of image height. No camera roll, no fisheye, no high aerial/isometric view. Do not place large foreground objects across the center; the separate foreground will be produced later.
Exact scope: SILENT HILL f, normal Fog World Ebisugaoka main street, the wooden corner shop seen in both official PlayStation screenshots. Images 1 and 2 are visual references for the SAME shop and same normal phase; use Image 1 as primary architecture and Image 2 only to clarify the frontage. Recompose this one storefront and its immediate neighbors as a side-facing combat backdrop: dark weathered timber two-story building, tile eaves, latticed upper windows and small balcony, faded rectangular shop sign, glazed lower shopfront, red cylindrical postbox to the left of the entrance, low wooden bench, slim utility pole and overhead power wires, adjoining slatted wall and distant side alley right. Grey cloudy daytime with a little low fog; wet granular grey road and restrained small puddles. Match roofline, facade proportions, postbox design, wood tone, dull blue-grey atmosphere and spacing as closely as the sources show. Use a wide nearly straight-on camera opposite this facade, with just enough depth at the right alley. The sign lettering must remain worn and indistinct; do not add readable invented words. Do not mix the red floral Otherworld, shrine, school, or Shimizu residence into this street. No flowers, vines, creatures, modern vehicles, road signs or extra props.
